form.inlineMessage: Thank you for your request. We have received your information. Please note that we are currently working on a backlog of requests and we appreciate your patience!

richText.content:
We prioritize requests for academic and research institutions, nonprofit organizations, and government entities. We review all other requests on a case-by-case basis in accordance with applicable laws and regulations. Thank you for your patience!

If you need to regain access to your previous inactive key, please submit a new request.

fields.name: email
fields.label: Email
fields.description: Please use an academic or corporate email. If your key is intended to be used for a company/organization, consider using a persistent identity so that you can receive important notifications.

fields.name: company
fields.label: Affiliation
fields.placeholder: Full name of company or other formal affiliation entity. Do not abbreviate.

fields.name: website
fields.label: Affiliation website URL
fields.placeholder: Link to company or other formal affiliation website.

options.label: South Georgia and the South Sandwich Islands
options.value: South Georgia and the South Sandwich Islands

fields.name: country
fields.label: Country/Region
fields.description: If you are based in Ukraine, please specify your region.

fields.name: message
fields.label: How do you plan to use Semantic Scholar API in your project? (50 words or more)
fields.description: Describe your project in detail regarding which endpoints and fields are needed, how much usage and users you expect to see, and how you plan to structure your requests to maintain efficiency.

fields.name: api_endpoints
fields.label: Which endpoints do you plan to use?
fields.description: Specify at least one of our API endpoints that you intend to use.

fields.name: api_requests_per_second
fields.label: How many requests per day do you anticipate using?
fields.description: Note that our introductory rate limit is 1 rate per second on all endpoints.

fields.name: api_successful_unauth_requests
fields.label: I have already successfully made unauthenticated requests

fields.name: api_acknowledge_rate_plans
fields.label: I acknowledge that there are only 2 rate plans

fields.name: api_protect_from_overloading
fields.label: I will apply exponential backoff and similar strategies to help protect our systems from overloading

fields.name: api_inactive_keys
fields.label: I understand that keys that are seen to be inactive for approximately 60 or more days may be removed

fields.name: agree_to_api_terms
fields.label: I have read and agree to Semantic Scholar™ API License Agreement
